subject: Deep dive next steps: finalize slot, bridge link, and attendee roster
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Parker <olivia.parker@nhsconnect.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 15:12:00 +0100
Subject: Quick follow-up & proposed deep-dive times (recap + attendees)

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the discovery call today — appreciate the level of detail you and Tom walked through around throughput and isolation requirements. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock a technical deep dive: 

- Goal for the deep dive: validate architecture, sizing, and networking requirements (VPC peering options and KMS) and demo a short run of a representative request profile.
- Can you confirm which of the following windows works best for your team (all times in BST):
    • Mon, 31 May — 09:00–10:00
    • Tue, 1 Jun — 10:00–11:00
    • Tue, 1 Jun — 15:00–16:00

Please let me know: 1) preferred slot, 2) who we should include from your side (engineering/SRE, security/compliance, procurement), and 3) whether you prefer Google Meet or Zoom for the bridge. We can share a calendar invite with the meeting link and attach the mutual action plan draft and the one-pager I referenced.

Attaching the one-pager and a first-pass MAP for your review. If Tuesday morning works, I can get an invite over within the hour.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0122
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_solution_one-pager.pdf; mutual-action-plan-draft.docx

From: Olivia Parker <olivia.parker@nhsconnect.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@nhsconnect.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:04:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & proposed deep-dive times (recap + attendees)

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear recap. We definitely want the technical deep dive — please include our SRE, Tom Ellis (copied), and our Data Protection Officer, Mia Chen (mia.chen@nhsconnect.com). Of the slots you proposed, Tue, 1 Jun 10:00–11:00 BST is our preference.

A couple of asks from our side:
- We prefer Google Meet if that’s possible.
- Can you include the mutual action plan in the calendar invite and note whether the session will be recorded? We need to confirm this internally.
- We’d also like the invite to call out who on your side will cover model sizing vs. networking so we can align internal attendees.

If you can send the invite and include a Meet link and the MAP attachment, I’ll confirm attendees on our side and loop in procurement if needed.

Best,
Olivia
Head of Platform Engineering | NHS Connect
olivia.parker@nhsconnect.com

Hi all —

Per Olivia’s note, I’ve scheduled the technical deep dive:

When: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 — 10:00–11:00 BST
Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij
Organizer: Vanessa Ortiz (Redwood Inference)
Recording: TBD — Olivia, if you confirm recording is OK we’ll enable it; otherwise we’ll take notes and share the session summary.

Agenda (45–50 min technical run + 10–15 min next steps):
- 10:00–10:05 — introductions & success criteria (Vanessa)
- 10:05–10:25 — architecture and network options (David Kim, Infra)
- 10:25–10:40 — model serving demo and cost/throughput considerations (Marissa Cole, Solutions)
- 10:40–10:50 — KV cache, prefix caching, and quantization tradeoffs (Marissa/David)
- 10:50–11:00 — Q&A & next steps / mutual action plan review

Attachments added to the invite: mutual-action-plan-draft.docx, redwood_solution_one-pager.pdf
Please confirm that the attendee list below is complete and accurate; I’ve marked roles we intend to cover from our side. If you want additional technical folks, we can expand the invite.

Attendee roster (so far):
- Olivia Parker — Head of Platform Engineering (NHS Connect)
- Tom Ellis — SRE (NHS Connect)
- Mia Chen — Data Protection Officer (NHS Connect)
- Vanessa Ortiz — Senior AE (Redwood Inference) — organizer
- David Kim — Infrastructure (Redwood Inference) — networking/VPC/KMS
- Marissa Cole — Solutions Engineer (Redwood Inference) — model serving/demo

If that looks good I’ll send the calendar invite from my Google account now (you should see it within a minute).

Thanks — looking forward to it.
